name: Kitakado Tomohisa
source:
Gentle and romantic, he has a prince-like aura. He grew up in a wealthy family who runs a hospital and, while he may be naive, he has a very pure heart and is never sarcastic.

He always thinks about what he can do for the other members.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#kitakadotomohisa]official website[/url]]
